summary.text: Dru Koester is the Libertarian candidate for Montana State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Erin Farris-Olsen for a seat with no incumbent.
A business owner who grew up on a farm in eastern Montana, Koester describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as "the peace candidate" in the race.

paragraphs.text: Dru Koester graduated from Shields Valley High School.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Koester wrote that she grew up on a farm in eastern Montana, attended a small school at the base of the Crazy Mountains, and cares about the Helena community.
Her stated campaign messages were avoiding foreign wars, lowering costs through free-market policies, and equal treatment under the justice system.
She listed protecting the National Guard from illegal wars, lower taxes, less spending and fewer regulations as policy priorities.
